beats.care: If you finished your degree by 1 November 2023 and live here, you can vote for an MLC who speaks for graduates.
beats.what: Enrolment is open for the Mahabubnagar-Rangareddy-Hyderabad and Warangal-Khammam-Nalgonda graduates' seats in Telangana's Legislative Council.
beats.why: Two seats fall vacant in March 2027. Parties are already naming candidates, and Kavitha's party named one on 20 October.

cards.body: Telangana has a Legislative Council, an upper house, besides its Assembly. Some of its members are elected only by graduates, so issues like jobs and exams get a voice there.
cards.title: what is a graduate mlc?

cards.body: Interest is falling. In Warangal-Khammam-Nalgonda, graduate voters dropped from 5.06 lakh in 2021 to 4.64 lakh. An election watch member says re-registering every time puts people off.
A diploma equal to a degree also counts, as long as it was finished three years before the qualifying date.

cards.q: Will you enrol as a graduate voter?

opts: The voter list is made fresh
cards.q: Why must past graduate voters register again?
cards.why: Graduate MLC rolls are rebuilt from scratch for each election, so everyone has to enrol again.

hook: Got your degree by Nov 2023? You get a *second vote*, if you enrol

learn.t: Graduate MLC voter lists are made fresh for each election, so even people who voted last time must register again.

tldr: Graduates in Hyderabad have until 6 November to enrol as voters for the Legislative Council's graduates' seat, even if they voted before.
watch: Last date to apply is 6 November. The draft list comes out on 25 November and the final list on 30 December.
